top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §747.4603)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A trampoline was observed in the living room and did not have the required 6ft around it clear as use zone.    Photos taken.    The trampoline was removed during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A total of one caregiver and ten children were observed inside the licensed childcare home. The maximum children allowed is seven children based on their age group. The licensed childcare home is out of ratio by three children.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not Licensed (26 TAC §HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not L)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is operating prior to receiving their permit.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have a copy of their educational documents on file for review.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies lacked information regarding parent rights.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.
